questions.question:
If x = 7, y = 4, z = 9, then which of the following is TRUE?

I. x + y + z = 20

II. x - y + z = 13

III. x + y - z = 3

IV. -x + y - z = -12

A. I and II

B. III and IV

C. I and IV

D. I and III
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x = 7, y = 4, z = 9

**Calculation:**

**I.** x + y + z = 20

LHS,

x + y + z = 7 + 4 + 9

⇒ x + y + z = 20

LHS = RHS

**II.** x – y + z = 13

LHS,

x – y + z = 7 – 4 + 9

⇒ x – y + z = 12

LHS ≠ RHS

**III.** x + y – z = 3

LHS,

x + y – z = 7 + 4 – 9

⇒ x + y – z = 2

LHS ≠ RHS

**IV.** -x + y – z = -12

LHS,

-x + y – z = -7 + 4 – 9

⇒ -x + y – z = -12

LHS = RHS

**∴**** I and IV are TRUE.**

questions.question:
The purchase price of 30 items is equal to the selling price of 40 items. Find the % of profit or loss in sales.

A. 20% loss

B. 25% profit

C. 25% loss

D. 20% profit
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of 30 items = SP of 40 items

**Formula used:**

Loss% = (CP – SP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

CP of 30 items = SP of 40 items

⇒ 30 × CP = 40 × SP

⇒ CP/SP = 40/30

⇒ SP/CP = 3/4

⇒ 1 – SP/CP = 1 – 3/4 [Subtract in 1 both sides]

⇒ (CP – SP)/CP = (4 – 3)/4

⇒ (CP – SP)/CP × 100 = 1/4 × 100 [Multiply 100 both sides]

⇒ Loss% = 25%

**∴ The loss% in sale is 25%.**

A trader marked 50% higher price on an article and later gave 20% discount on it. What percentage of profit did the merchant get after giving a discount?

 

A. 30%

B. 125%

C. 25%

D. 20%
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Markup% (M%) = 50%

Discount% (D%) = 20%

**Formula used:**

MP = CP × (100 + M%)/100

SP = MP × (100 – D%)/100

P% = (P/CP) × 100

Where, MP is Marked Price, SP is Selling Price, CP is Cost Price, M% is Markup%, P% is Profit%, and D% is Discount%

**Calculation:**

Let the CP be 100

MP = CP × (100 + M%)/100 = 100 × (100 + 50)/100

⇒ MP = 150

SP = MP × (100 – D%)/100 = 150 × (100 – 20)/100

⇒ SP = 120

P = SP – CP = 120 – 100 = 20

P% = (P/CP) × 100 = (20/100) × 100

**∴ Profit percentage is 20%**

n = Time

C. 3.5%

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Change in length = 15%

Change in breadth = -10%

**Formula used:**

(i) Percentage change = {(New value - Old value)/Old value} × 100

(ii) Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculations:**

Let the initial length and breadth be 100x and 100y respectively.

Initial area = 100x × 100y

⇒ 10,000xy

New length = 100x + 100x × (15/100)

⇒ 115x

New breadth = 100y - 100y × (90/100)

⇒ 90y

New area = 115x × 90y

⇒ 10,350xy

Percentage change = {(10,350xy - 10,000xy)/10,000xy} × 100

⇒ (350xy/10,000xy) × 100

⇒ 3.5%

∴ The percentage change in the area of the rectangle is 3.5%.

Which of the following is a vector quantity?

B. Temperature

C. Distance

questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Velocity**__.

__
 
• Velocity is a vector quantity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Physical quantities which have **magnitude only** and no direction are called** scalar quantities.**
 
• Example: **Mass, Speed, Volume, etc.**
 
• **Vector Quantities:**
 
 
• Physical quantities that have **magnitude and direction both** and which obey **triangle law **are called **vector quantities**. 
 
• Example: Displacement, Velocity, etc. 
 
 
 
• Distance is the length of the actual path covered by a moving object in a given time interval.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The difference between the final and the initial position of an object is called displacement. 
 
 
• It is a vector quantity.
 
• Its unit is meter.
 
 
 
• The velocity of a moving object is defined as the **displacement of the object in the unit time interval.**
 
• It is a **vector quantity** and its SI unit is meter/second.
 
• **Acceleration **of an object is defined as the** rate of change of velocity of the object.**
 
 
• It is a **vector quantity** and its SI **unit is (m/s²)**.
